notes: §1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR3: "Within a given report group description entry, all absolute LINE NUMBER clauses must precede all relative LINE NUMBER clauses." ReportSectionBinder.ScreenReportGroupLines compares every pair of a group's written LINE entries and refuses (COBOL2199, §2023:13.18.35.3 SR6 e)) an absolute line described after a relative one unless DifferentPresentWhen excuses them; at 85 that excuse is unreachable, because PRESENT WHEN (and the multiple LINE clause that SR10 b) orders) is refused there with COBOL0900, and a line's clause list holds only PRESENT WHEN clauses (an item's GROUP INDICATE does not excuse a line). Probes at 85 (work-slice-54/c7*; classes b, c, d): absolute-relative-absolute, relative-absolute, LINE 5 ON NEXT PAGE then PLUS 0 then LINE 7, and a GROUP INDICATE item on the later absolute line each print COBOL2199; LINE 3 PLUS 1 and PRESENT WHEN print COBOL0900; absolute 3, 6 then PLUS 1, PLUS 2 runs. The witness (LINE 5, PLUS 1, LINE 9) is refused with COBOL2199.

next.reason: 1985: 'all absolute LINE NUMBER clauses must precede all relative LINE NUMBER clauses', without exception. §2023:13.18.35.3 SR6e: if an absolute line's description appears later than a relative line's, 'they shall each be subject to a different PRESENT WHEN clause' - accepted in that case; within one multiple LINE clause 'All absolute operands ... shall precede all relative operands' (§2023:13.18.35.3 SR10b). A 1985 program (no PRESENT WHEN) is refused the same way; 2023 accepts sources 1985 refused. Looser.
